name: Garci Sánchez de Badajoz
bio: Garci Sánchez de Badajoz (c. 1460–c. 1526) was a Spanish court poet whose verse appears in the Cancionero general of 1511. Despite his name, he is stated to have been born at Écija in Andalusia.
He was famed for his love poetry, written in the courtly manner of the cancioneros, and by tradition an unhappy love affair drove him mad; he is said to have died insane at Badajoz.

poems.title: Villancico: Lo que queda es lo seguro
poems.author: Garci Sánchez de Badajoz
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Spanish Verse (1913)
poems.text:
Lo que queda es lo seguro,
que lo que comigo va
desseand' os morira.

Mi anima queda aqui,
señora, en vuestra prision,
partida del coracon
del dolor con que parti;
mas los ojos con que os vi,
y el cuerpo que n' os vera,
desseand' os morira.
